storylines.title: Iran War
storylines.overview: The Iran War is a sustained international conflict centered on Iran, the United States and Israel, with military, maritime, economic and diplomatic consequences across the Persian Gulf and neighboring states. U.S. combat operations began on February 28, 2026, and security in the Strait of Hormuz has remained one of the conflict's central pressure points.
storylines.current_status: A Russian warship, the Merkury, was reportedly struck by a suspected Ukrainian drone while docked at the naval base in Benghazi, Libya. The explosion caused significant damage to the vessel and ignited a fire at the facility. Local officials indicated that the ship was in Libya for fuel and supplies on its return journey to Russia. No group has claimed responsibility for the attack, which raises concerns about the implications for regional security amid the ongoing Russia-Ukraine conflict.
